altText: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women beside reeds and shallow-water reflections under a wooden shade shelter. A braided woman and a blonde woman share a side hug while a seated woman touches their forearms and another leans toward her temple. They wear opaque emerald, ivory-and-navy, and green-white-red-black color-blocked mini outfits with covered midriffs. Pearl-trimmed reed patterns, agency and silent king arm tattoos, navy boots and rainbow knee-high boots appear in the diagonally framed scene.
